summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Timeline Replay Documentary Engine. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_replay.py covering (a) /api/replay/bounds shape + auth (401/403 without Bearer), ISO parseability, earliest<=latest; (b) /api/replay LIVE snapshot: events_after==0, events_seen==full ledger count (466 for demo user via /api/ledger/events), response.at==server.now, state has all 14 required counters, no counter is negative, recent_events<=20 and monotonically newest-first; (c) /api/replay?at=<earliest> returns exactly events_seen==1 and events_after==(total-1) and first event folded; (d) /api/replay?at=<mid> events_seen strictly less than LIVE, events_after>0, and (events_seen+events_after)==LIVE.events_seen; (e) monotonic behaviour across 4 fractions (0.1/0.3/0.6/0.9) — events_seen never decreases; (f) /api/replay?at=<pre-history: earliest-365d> returns events_seen==0, events_after==total, every state counter == 0, recent_events==[]; (g) malformed 'not-a-timestamp' AND empty string fall back to server-now (200, events_after==0, no 400/500); (h) fold correctness: client-side re-fold of the full ledger (all 466 events pulled via /api/ledger/events?limit=10000, sorted chronologically) matches server state field-for-field for all 14 counters including memory_strength point-in-time semantics and concepts_extracted += len(meta.concepts); (i) open_contradictions >= 0 across 7 sample timestamps (never goes negative); (j) recent_events all have created_at <= at at mid-point. Regressions all pass: /api/timeline still returns events (capped at 300, this is the pre-existing production limit — noted for main agent), /api/ledger/verify still 200, /api/auth/forgot-password known-email still 200, /api/auth/reset-password bad code still 400, /api/auth/admin/reset-password still 503 with ADMIN_RESET_TOKEN unset (payload must include admin_token field to bypass 422 validation, verified). FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844): Logged in as demo@pocketos.app, navigated to Timeline tab. testID='replay-card' rendered with the 'REALITY AS OF' label and 'Now' timestamp. All 6 metric tiles present with testIDs metric-notes/memory/decisions/council/debates/contradictions showing 42/99%/41/63/16/17. Both scrubber-track and scrubber-handle present, LIVE pill visible initially. Drag test: page.mouse.down at handle center → small dx (5px) to arm PanResponder → 60% track-width leftward drag with steps=20 → mouse.up. After drag: LIVE pill replaced by testID='return-to-now', timestamp updated to 'Mon, Aug 10 · 20:59', metric tiles folded (notes 42→10, council 63→8, memory 99%→93%, decisions 41→16, debates 16→0, contradictions 17→0 — all shrunk as expected). testID='replay-footer' rendered: '89 events at or before this moment · 377 still to come'. Future events in the scroll list have opacity 0.3 (styles.rowFuture applied) and '· not yet' tag appended after the kind label (300 occurrences on-screen). Clicked testID='return-to-now' → state reverted to LIVE snapshot (notes 42, council 63), LIVE pill returned, return-to-now button removed. All contract points from the review request are satisfied. Two harmless deprecation warnings observed from react-native-web ('shadow* deprecated', 'pointerEvents deprecated') — pre-existing across the codebase, not introduced by this feature.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' appears in console. Pre-existing across many components (fab, cards). Not blocking; would need to migrate ALL styles to boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timeline.tsx:301, /app/frontend/src/components/TimeScrubber.tsx:233
Deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from an internal RNW component (not our code). Pre-existing. Not blocking.

action_items: None blocking. Feature is production-ready. Backend 27/27 tests green, frontend E2E scrubber-drag and return-to-now flows verified.

OPTIONAL: /api/timeline is capped at 300 events (existing behaviour), but /api/ledger/events has a 10000 cap. The Timeline tab's event list therefore may not show older events in a >300-event workspace even though the scrubber uses /api/replay which folds the FULL ledger. Consider bumping /api/timeline's to_list(300) if users need to see historical events beyond the last 300 in the visual list. Not a regression from this feature.
OPTIONAL: Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across the codebase to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate function name `replay` in server.py: `async def replay` at line 2256 (the new one) and another `async def replay` at line 3350 (for /replay/{note_id}). FastAPI dispatches by path so behaviour is correct — /api/replay/bounds matches first, /api/replay (no path) matches the new one, and /api/replay/{note_id} still resolves. But the shared Python function name is confusing for maintainers; consider renaming the older one to `note_replay` or the new one to `replay_at` for clarity.
server.py is now 3613 lines — should be split into modules (auth, notes, council, ledger, decisions, replay, forgot-password) for maintainability. Not blocking the current feature.

_fold_event only counts known kinds; unknown kinds (e.g. debate_turn_critic which is in _REPLAY_EVENT_KINDS but has no fold branch) are silently skipped. Currently that's fine because none of those kinds affect the derived state counters, but the _REPLAY_EVENT_KINDS set is dead code — remove or wire in per-kind counters.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing 466-event demo user ledger for all timeline/fold/scrubber tests. No writes to production-shaped data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_replay.py -v --tb=short -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/replay_results.xml`. Must be -n 0 (serial) to avoid xdist workers racing on the shared demo user. Playwright drag technique for the TimeScrubber PanResponder: (1) get bounding_box of [data-testid=scrubber-handle] and [data-testid=scrubber-track], (2) mouse.move to handle center, mouse.down, (3) small mouse.move of dx=5 to arm onPanResponderMove, (4) large mouse.move to end_x with steps=20 for smooth interpolation, (5) mouse.up, (6) wait ~4s for /api/replay round-trip. Verify metrics shrink and testID='return-to-now' appears. To test click-then-return: click return-to-now, wait ~3s, verify LIVE pill reappears and metric values match pre-drag values exactly.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — feature validation, no bug found. All 27 backend contract checks + end-to-end frontend drag/return flow verified. Fold correctness confirmed by pulling the full 466-event ledger via /api/ledger/events and independently re-computing all 14 counters — server state matches client re-fold field-for-field, proving the ledger IS the source of truth as designed.
